patterns.message: Do not import from `@traycer/protocol/.../_internal/...`. Use `getRecordSchema(<registry>, "<record-name>", "latest")` to obtain a versioned record schema, or use `RecordValue<typeof <registry>, "<record-name>">` for the type.
Client packages must not import `@traycerai/*` (for example packages/common). Use `@traycer/protocol/*` or `@traycer-clients/*` instead.
Client packages may only import `@traycer` through `@traycer/protocol/*`. Use the protocol path alias or `@traycer-clients/*` for other shared code.
